question: Which sport is the Wimbledon trophy associated with?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lawn Tennis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Wimbledon Championships**, commonly known simply as **Wimbledon**, is the oldest lawn tennis tournament in the world. 
 
• [IMAGE: https://www.ft.com/__origami/service/image/v2/images/raw/http%3A%2F%2Fcom.ft.imagepublish.upp-prod-eu.s3.amazonaws.com%2F1f60db6a-67d0-11e7-9a66-93fb352ba1fe?source=next-article&fit=scale-down&quality=highest&width=700&dpr=1] 
 
• It is held every year at** All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club** in Wimbledon, **London**,** the United Kingdom**.
 
• The All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club is a private club founded on** 23 July 1868**, originally as "The All England Croquet Club". In 1877, the club was renamed "The All England Croquet and Lawn Tennis Club".
 
• Wimbledon is played on outdoor "Grass courts", with retractable roofs over the two main courts since 2019. During The Championships the height of the grass will be 8mm.
 
• The Centre Court at Wimbledon is also known by the famous postcode **SW19**.
 
• In the Wimbledon tournament players follow a strict all-white dress code. Strawberries and cream are traditionally consumed at the tournament by all the players.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Wimbledon is one of the **four **Grand Slam tennis tournaments.
 
• Wimbledon is the only Grand Slam that does not conduct night matches, it conducts only day matches imposing a night curfew instead.
